note: Requests for intake tests: ground-truth probes, synthetic routing cases and the forty coverage requests. All cases are synthetic, with made-up analysis names, model points and numbers; the labelled variants carry generic context labels. Data only; no code keys on an identifier here.

cases.prompt: What would a 10 TeV muon collider tell us about the Higgs self-coupling?
Estimate the irreducible background to a displaced dimuon dark-photon search at LHCb.
Compare the ATLAS and CMS ttbar spin-correlation measurements and tell me if they agree.
Train a graph network to tag boosted Higgs to bb and compare with ParticleNet.
Is there a consistent explanation of the W mass anomaly with a scalar triplet?
Fit the three-jet energy-imbalance spectrum for the fictional Clockwork decay model and report the allowed lifetime range using synthetic record 990000002.
Fit the SMEFT Wilson coefficients to the published STXS measurements.
Write a short paper summarizing the results in run A.
Predict the binned signal yield in the CMS stop search for a 700 GeV stop and a 100 GeV neutralino and fill the template.
Evaluate 1.2e-3 * 139 * 1000 and state the answer in events, taking the inputs as a cross section in pb and an integrated luminosity in fb^-1.
Take a sequential-standard-model Z' with a 3 TeV mass and compute its tree-level partial width into e+e- and its branching ratio into charged leptons, writing out the formula you use.
Recreate the observed 95% CL exclusion contour in the (m_slepton, delta m) plane for slepton-pair production from the ATLAS compressed-slepton search arXiv:{{arxiv:32}} ({{analysis:1}}).

Would the CMS multilepton search {{analysis:479}} exclude a 600 GeV wino-like chargino-neutralino pair that decays via WZ into a 200 GeV bino? Work from the published likelihood or the published counts where they exist.

In the fictional Quartz model, a charged scalar produces a photon and a jet. Summarize the published exclusion limits from fictional searches {{analysis:901:91}} and {{analysis:902:92}} in a figure of photon-jet invariant mass below 875 GeV.

Assume a displaced electron-photon excess comes from the fictional Lantern tensor model. Compare the existing exclusion limits on its transverse decay length from fictional searches {{analysis:903:93}} and {{analysis:904:94}}, and draw a summary figure.

For the fictional Mosaic model producing two tau jets and missing momentum, scan the parent and invisible-particle masses using fictional search {{analysis:905:95}}. Report expected limits in transverse mass and estimate the gain from a tau-polarization classifier.

Constrain the SMEFT Wilson coefficients c_HW and c_HB at linear order with the 13 TeV Higgs simplified template cross-section measurements of ATLAS and CMS, keeping the correlations between their uncertainties.
I attach events.hepmc, a HepMC file holding 50k ttbar events at 13 TeV. Run the Rivet routine SYN_9256_I1242 over it and give me the normalized distributions compared with the measured data.

Here is the Lagrangian of a scalar leptoquark S1 that couples an electron to an up quark with strength lambda: L = lambda * S1 * (e^c u^c)^* + h.c. Build the model, generate pp -> S1 -> e j at 13 TeV with lepton PDFs for M = 3 TeV, Gamma = 60 GeV and lambda = 1, and plot the electron-jet invariant mass after an ATLAS-like detector simulation and selection.

For pp -> a W gamma with W -> l nu at 13 TeV, compute at parton level the normalized missing-transverse-energy distribution in the ALP effective theory with c_W-tilde = 1 and c_B-tilde = -tan^2(theta_W) (which removes the ALP-photon coupling), f_a = 1 TeV and m_a = 1 MeV.

For a kinetically mixed U(1)' Z', compute the expected 2-sigma exclusion contour in the (g-tilde, g1') coupling plane at the 8 TeV LHC with 20 fb^-1, for M_Z' = 2, 2.5 and 3 TeV in Drell-Yan dileptons, using the significance 2(sqrt(S+B) - sqrt(B)) and a 60% acceptance.

Recast the 13 TeV mono-tau searches of ATLAS and CMS (arXiv:{{arxiv:490}}, {{arxiv:491}}) to bound a U1 vector leptoquark coupled to b-tau and c-nu, and derive the 2-sigma excluded region in (sqrt(|g_c g_b|), M_U1) for M_U1 from 750 GeV to 5 TeV.

Implement the search analysis of the attached paper (EXAMPLE-ANA-001) and predict with it the binned differential signal yield in E_T^miss for the model point ModelA_700_150 (a 700 GeV chargino and a 150 GeV LSP) in the two-lepton signal region, at 13 TeV and 59.7 fb^-1. Fill the attached results template without changing its bin edges. Do not extract bin values from the paper's figures or from HEPData.

Determine how strongly the diphoton acoplanarity spectrum constrains the interference coupling of the fictional Compass model. Fit the synthetic spectrum at 17 TeV, HEPData 000009901, 0.042 fb^-1, with the Rivet routine SYN_9900_I7000001; compare the allowed coupling with the zero-interference hypothesis.

Using supplied synthetic electron-photon events at 17 TeV and 0.042 fb^-1, optimize a blinded search in missing transverse momentum for the fictional Prism and Lantern models. Validate a background estimate in control regions, report expected sensitivity, and write a six-page internal note.

Validate a background estimate in control regions, report expected sensitivity, and write a six-page internal note.

Develop and evaluate a CWoLa-style weakly supervised anomaly-detection method for dijet resonance searches on my supplied dijet events with an injected signal, and compare its sensitivity with a cut-based baseline.
With CAMB, compute the lensed CMB TT and EE power spectra up to l = 2500 for the Planck 2018 best-fit LCDM parameters and compare them with CLASS.
Using flavio, compute how the angular observable P5' in B -> K* mu mu shifts in the 4 < q^2 < 6 GeV^2 bin for a new-physics Wilson coefficient C9 = -1 at the b-quark scale.
From the results in my run directory runs/stau-fit, write an EPJC-formatted paper with an abstract, figures, citations and a methods section, and produce the PDF.
Which LHC searches constrain compressed slepton spectra whose mass splittings are below 20 GeV, and what are the strongest limits they set today?
Generate 10,000 Drell-Yan e+e- events at 13 TeV with MadGraph and Pythia, then plot the dielectron invariant mass between 60 and 120 GeV in the produced sample.
Draw every tree-level Feynman diagram of g g -> t t-bar H in the Standard Model.

Estimate the Belle II reach for τ → μγ with 50 ab⁻¹.
Use ATLAS internal Run-3 data to measure the Higgs width.
